# Copilot instructions

Use the root `AGENTS.md` for repository-wide guidance. Apply `frontend/AGENTS.md` to frontend work and `backend/AGENTS.md` to backend work.

The project is a new React + TypeScript frontend and .NET 10 ASP.NET Core backend. The application has not been scaffolded and product requirements are not yet defined. Follow the guidance files before generating code, and do not invent features or infrastructure.
